Claude Fable 5 designed a robot joint in 30 minutes: motor, gearbox, housing.

It animated the gearbox and checked for part collisions before handing the design over. Demo by engineer Jake Fitzgerald, video is his.

The part isn't the story. The self-check is what CAD tools get paid for.

Spun it around in the browser viewer: output stack, motor windings, housing, an electronics board. A 4.5:1 gear reduction that actually animates.

400k tokens of design, simulate, inspect. Game clones test recall. This has to physically fit together and spin.

Fair caveat: an animation isn't a stress test, and we haven't seen the prompts end to end.

Jake shipped the whole loop as open-source skills: https://t.co/rjqX0EHMdU

The finished part is spinnable at https://t.co/wnZhoFaitj.
